historical_claims.anchor: The Joad family has been driven off the land it worked in Oklahoma.
At the Colorado River, Noah decides he will stay rather than continue.
At a rough camp often called a Hooverville, Tom and Casy try to help when labor recruiters arrive.
The Joads then reach a government-run migrant camp, modeled in part on real camps that existed in California.
Tom slips out and finds Casy, released from jail and now organizing among the farmworkers.
Rose of Sharon offers her breast to the dying stranger and feeds him.
